about.heading: Bringing culture and context into the club.
about.story: Rooted between Amman and Bremen, Nahawandi builds danceable electronic grooves around cultural moments, rhythmic systems, voices and fragments drawn from different worlds—reworking them into high-energy electronic frameworks with unexpected twists.
about.maqam: Derived from the Arabic maqam Nahawand, the name Nahawandi reflects his commitment to bringing new melodic perspectives to contemporary electronic music.
